title: Payment Service Architecture
content: The Payment Service authenticates internal service calls using signed JWT tokens. All downstream checkout and invoice services must validate JWT claims before processing payment events.
author: Arun Kumar

title: Deployment Checklist
content: Production deployments for customer-facing services happen every Friday at 6 PM after QA sign-off. Hotfixes require approval from Engineering Manager and Support Lead.
author: Meera S

title: Enterprise Customer Onboarding SOP
content: Customer Success owns enterprise onboarding after contract signature. Engineering is involved only when custom integration work is approved.
author: Divya N

title: Incident Response Policy
content: Severity 1 incidents require immediate escalation to the on-call engineer, engineering manager, and customer support lead. A postmortem must be published within 48 hours.
author: Karthik V
